description: Elena must arrange temporary care for the family's dog, Pippin, while their aunt is recovering, deciding who will take Pippin, what daily routine to follow, and when care will end with input from her brother Jordan and cousin Mia.

shared_context.S1: Pippin needs a temporary home from July 5 through July 14 while their aunt recovers from a hospital stay.
shared_context.S2: Elena is coordinating Pippin's care and will make the final plan.
shared_context.S3: Pippin is an older dog who is accustomed to familiar people and a regular daily routine.
shared_context.S4: Before Elena settles the plan, the family habit is to do a quick round where each person says what they can handle and mentions any care instructions they have.
shared_context.S5: Pippin's leash, food, crate, and regular supplies are available at the aunt's house.

PF1.text: Mia has the veterinarian's discharge sheet from this week's visit. It says Pippin must stay on one floor, receive three 20-minute leash walks each day, and get medication at exactly 08:00 and 20:00 through July 14; Mia has not shown the sheet to Elena yet.

PF2.text: Jordan's landlord confirmed that Jordan can keep Pippin in Jordan's enclosed ground-floor mudroom and fenced yard through July 14, after which Pippin must be returned to the aunt's house; Jordan has not yet told Elena about that confirmation.

acceptance_conditions: Jordan must be named as Pippin's primary temporary caretaker.
Pippin's care area must be Jordan's enclosed ground-floor mudroom and fenced yard.
The plan must include exactly three 20-minute leash walks per day.
The medication times must be exactly 08:00 and 20:00.
Pippin must be returned to the aunt's house on July 14.
A commitment naming Jordan for hosting, care, care instructions, or return must be recorded.
Mia's veterinarian discharge instructions must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C2: 'ground-floor' in decisions['dog_area'] and 'mudroom' in decisions['dog_area'] and 'fenced yard' in decisions['dog_area']
content_checks.C4: (decisions['medication_times'] == ['08:00', '20:00'] or decisions['medication_times'] == ['8:00 AM', '8:00 PM']) and any('20-minute' in c['detail'] and ('three' in c['detail'] or '3' in c['detail']) and 'walk' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: decisions['temporary_caretaker'] == 'Jordan' and 'ground-floor' in decisions['dog_area'] and 'mudroom' in decisions['dog_area'] and 'fenced yard' in decisions['dog_area'] and decisions['return_date'] == 'July 14' and any(c['target'] == 'Jordan' and ('house' in c['detail'] or 'Keep' in c['detail'] or 'keep' in c['detail'] or 'Return' in c['detail'] or 'return' in c['detail'] or 'care' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The discharge sheet changes the routine from an unspecified generic schedule to exactly three 20-minute walks daily and medication at 08:00 and 20:00.

The landlord's confirmation changes the placement to Jordan's specified ground-floor area, establishes Jordan as caretaker through July 14, and supports commitments to house Pippin there and return Pippin to the aunt's house on July 14.
